Parth Jindal Appointed Chairman of JSW MG Motor India

Parth Jindal has been appointed the new chairman of JSW MG Motor India. His appointment comes as the automaker enters an expansion phase. Jindal has been involved in shaping the company's product strategy, manufacturing expansion, and localization efforts for the SAIC-JSW joint venture. His role is expected to focus on driving the electric vehicle (EV) expansion for the company.
